# Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI Agent readiness and resiliency with SharePoint Content Governance

[Sesha_Mani's avatar](https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/users/sesha_mani/85036)

[Sesha\_Mani](https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/users/sesha_mani/85036)

Nov 17, 2026

**In the AI era, governance isn't a barrier to innovation. It's what makes innovation possible at scale.**

Winning with Copilot and AI agents takes more than speed and scale. It requires **readiness to embrace AI and resilience to recover when things go wrong** . That's the power of AI-first governance: accelerating innovation, strengthening trust, and maximizing AI return on investment.

Today at Microsoft Ignite ’26, we're announcing exciting new content governance innovations to help organizations accelerate their [Frontier Transformation](https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2026/03/09/introducing-the-first-frontier-suite-built-on-intelligence-trust/) with AI Agents, Autopilots, Agent 365, and Work IQ.

## Governance innovations for resilient AI at scale

As you unveil AI Agents in your organization, either just getting started or deploying at scale, content governance becomes even more important to get right. **SharePoint is the #1 content citation source in Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI Agents** . Let us look into SharePoint content governance innovations across two main themes - readiness and resiliency, along with foundational security and enterprise lifecycle scenarios.

**Readiness for AI at scale** addresses oversharing, content lifecycle and sprawl, the risks boards now see as the biggest obstacles to AI transformation. New agentic skills power new security and storage management capabilities to address them.

**Resilient AI** is all about business continuity, especially in the era where agents are integral part of the workforce. Organizations must be prepared for unforeseen situations such as an agent going rogue and accidentally deleting content.

With this backdrop, let us dive into innovations across the following pillars:

Readiness for Copilot and AI Agents at Scale

SharePoint Admin Agent - Enhancements

Govern agents' traffic to M365 resources

Enhancements in SharePoint oversharing controls

Resilient AI: Business continuity even when agents go off script

Rewind when agents go off script

Microsoft 365 Backup: Teams support

Entra Backup

Security and Compliance capabilities in SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams

Microsoft 365 Storage Management and Enterprise Lifecycle

## Readiness for Copilot and AI Agents at Scale

Readiness is about ensuring your content is permissioned rightfully, organized in manageable clusters, has lifecycle guardrails, and in parallel knowing agent traffic across your Microsoft 365 estate _before_ AI Agents use it.

We are bringing many innovations to Copilot native governance capabilities powered by SAM (SharePoint Advanced Management) and to agent governance in the lens of Microsoft 365 resources. Let’s dive in.

#### 1\. SharePoint Admin Agent – Generally Available

At [Microsoft 365 Confernece’26](https://www.m365conf.com/) , we introduced the [SharePoint Admin Agent](https://aka.ms/M365-governance-agent) , Microsoft’s first-party AI assistant for managing your rapidly growing digital estate across Microsoft 365.

As the content backbone of Microsoft 365, SharePoint powers Teams, OneDrive, Loop, Copilot, and more. It sits at the center of content governance, spanning permissions, lifecycle, resilience, and relevance across users, apps, and now, AI agents.

The SharePoint Admin Agent brings these capabilities together in one simple conversational experience, with powerful skills across Permissions and Oversharing Management, Storage, Lifecycle, Multi-Geo, and Catalog. Today we are thrilled to announce many enhancements in the admin agent.

SharePoint Admin Agent skills

#### SharePoint Admin Agent’s Starter Prompts:

You can try various starter prompts categorized under various skills: Catalog, Permissions, Lifecycle, Storage, Organizational Settings and Multi-Geo.

#### Permissions and Oversharing Management skill – Generally Available

Admins can detect oversharing, see who has access to what and protect sensitive content, all in plain language. Ask _"Find overshared sites in my tenant"_ and the agent builds a prioritized list to review and act on, whether you have hundreds of sites or millions.

_SharePoint admin sees the permissions and oversharing skills of the SharePoint Management Agent in action._

#### Lifecycle skill – Generally Available

Ensuring content is current is critical to ensuring that Copilot serves the right content and with optimal utilization of storage. Helps admins stay in control of content from creation to end of life by identifying inactive, outdated, and ownerless sites and enabling actions like reviews and archival. For example, you could simply ask the agent: “ _List my inactive and ownerless sites_ ”.

_SharePoint admin sees the lifecycle skill of the SharePoint Management Agent in action._

#### Storage skill – Generally Available

Gives admins a clear view of tenant storage trends and active-versus-archive growth, helping them identify content sprawl, optimize capacity, and reduce unnecessary costs with confidence.

Here are some of the prompts that you can use in this v2 release, more enhancements are upcoming.

_"Compare active and archive SharePoint storage growth"_

_"Help me set up a file archive policy"_

_"How much version storage is used across the tenant?"_

_SharePoint admin sees the storage skill of the SharePoint Management Agent in action._

#### Multi-Geo skill – Generally Available

[Microsoft 365 Multi-Geo](https://aka.ms/M365MultiGeo) enables customers to comply with their organization's data residency requirements by ensuring that users' data is hosted within a specific geo where the user is located. The new **Multi-Geo skill in SharePoint Admin agent** assists the admin in moving the OneDrives to the user’s Preferred Data Location (PDL) along with following key capabilities:

* **Identify content to be moved**
* **Initiate moves:** Move OneDrive to users' Preferred Data Locations.
* **Monitor moves:** Track the status and progress of ongoing moves across OneDrive, SharePoint sites, and Microsoft 365 Groups.

The SharePoint admin sees the Multi-Geo skill in action.

#### Catalog skill – General Availability

The Catalog skill connects the SharePoint Admin Agent to Catalog Management, so the agent understands your tenant the way your business is organized. Using built-in categories like Department and Locale, along with any custom categories you've added, the agent can:

* **Show how content is organized in your tenant:** View site counts, site lists and groups of content in Catalog.
* **Organize content using the skill:** Leverage Catalog skill to create most relevant groups of SharePoint sites and OneDrive accounts with recommendations such as group sites in a certain department that are Highly Confidential.
* **Recommend next steps:** such as inactive content cleanup, archiving, version-history limits or a permissions review, scoped to the right group of sites instead of the whole tenant.

The SharePoint admin sees the catalog management skill in action.

#### Governance Hub for Admins – Generally Available Dec. 2026

As organizations accelerate their AI transformation, content governance can quickly become overwhelming. Admins don’t need more reports. They need to know what needs attention, what to do next, and have a simple way to act.

Today, we’re thrilled to introduce **Governance Hub** for Admins, **powered by the SharePoint Admin Agent** . It is readily available in Home tab of the SharePoint Admin Center and brings assessments, findings, recommendations, and actionable tasks together into a single experience - helping admins move from insight to action and govern content at scale

The SharePoint Admin Agent helps govern content from a single experience.

#### 2\. Agent governance in the lens of Microsoft 365 resources SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams

SharePoint and Teams administrators often ask – for my top secret and confidential resources, which agents are accessing them and who instantiated them, can I control at site or team level which agents are allowed? We have an answer for you.

Agent 365 offers a breadth view of all agents in your enterprise. To complement that breadth view, we are introducing depth view of agents in the lens of Microsoft 365 resources, specifically SharePoint sites, Teams, and OneDrive under the umbrella of Agent Lineage.

The new **Agent governance** node in the SharePoint admin center puts every agent governance action against Microsoft 365 resources in one place. Admins can go from insight to action without switching between reports and settings.

Govern how agents are interacting with content.

**Start with the Overview.** The Overview page gives you the big picture: how many agents are accessing your Microsoft 365 content, which agents and resources are most active, which content Microsoft 365 Copilot uses most, and how that access breaks down by sensitivity label and department. Suggested actions, such as restricted access control (RAC), restricted content discovery (RCD) and site access reviews, are one click away.

**Drill down with the Agent Access Heatmap.** It provides a panoramic view of your Microsoft 365 resources be it millions of SharePoint or OneDrive sites or Teams along with the agentic traffic.

#### Agent Access Heatmap for SharePoint and OneDrive – General Availability Dec’26

Agent Access Heatmap extends Microsoft Agent 365 capabilities with content context. The heatmap offers rich visual insights on agent access with additional dimensions like sensitivity, departments, and agent platforms – giving you visibility in a single view. Admins now have effective tools for observing and governing agent actions like pausing agentic access to a site or scoping more granular access. Find the busiest areas, then apply the appropriate content guardrails as needed.

#### Control whom an agentic user can collaborate with – Public Preview Dec. 2026

As agentic users proliferate in your organization, they can accumulate content permissions and further share it with other users in your organization while performing their work, like human users. To ensure agentic users securely collaborate with other users and in essence of work, you need a simple way to control which users the agentic users can collaborate with. We are thrilled to introduce a control that does just that.

When a new agent template is onboarded in Agent 365 portal, you can turn on the setting for “Restrict collaboration by agentic users” which will ensure agentic users associated with this agent template can only share sites and content with their manager.

Control with whom agentic users can collaborate.

While AI admins can set the collaboration boundary when onboarding an agent template in Agent 365,

SharePoint admins can now manage it, along with the rest of their agent content guardrails, from the new Settings page under Agent Governance in the SharePoint admin center. What you observe in the Agent Access Heatmap, you can now act on in **Settings** .

Agent governance settings.

#### Restricted access for apps and agents at site level – General Availability

Every Entra registered agent has a blueprint identity, much like third-party applications. The agent blueprints and applications with broad reaching permission across all sites or teams in your organization can increase the risk of data disclosure. We are thrilled to introduce restricted app access control - a [new setting](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sharepoint/restrict-application-agent-access#:~:text=Application%20Restrictions%20helps%20prevent%20oversharing%20to%20applications%20by,they%20hold%20Microsoft%20Entra%20consent%20and%20SharePoint%20permissions.) that empowers SharePoint Administrators to achieve fine-grained permissions by restricting which 3rd party applications or agent blueprints can access specific business critical sites or high-profile users' OneDrive data.

Simply run the cmdlet below using SharePoint Online Management PowerShell:

_Set-SPOSiteRestrictedAppAccessControlList –Identity <SiteURL> -ListType DenyList -AddRestrictedAppIds <ApporAgentBlueprintIDs>_

#### 3\. Enhancements in content oversharing controls from SharePoint Advanced Management (SAM)

#### Permissions and oversharing report for Autopilots & Groups - Generally Available

Site Permissions reports now extend to Microsoft 365 and Security Groups and Autopilots, enabling admins to instantly identify every site a user/group or autopilot can access and the scope of that access — closing a critical blind spot in oversharing governance. And clear remediation pathways are available through Restricted Access Control (RAC) and Restricted Content Discovery (RCD) policies.

[Learn more](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sharepoint/data-access-governance-reports) .

_SharePoint admin viewing permissions report for specific Autopilots users have instantiated_ _SharePoint admin viewing permissions report for specific large security groups._

#### Catalog management with custom SharePoint Properties – Generally Available

At Microsoft 365 Conference’26 we introduced [Catalog Management](https://aka.ms/CatalogManagement) V1. It brings order to sprawling SharePoint estates by grouping sites the way your business actually works: by department, region, project or function. The result is a central catalog of sites you can understand, govern and get ready for Copilot and agents.

Today, we're taking it further. You can now tailor Catalog Management to your tenant using information you already have. There are three new ways to customize your catalog:

1. **Custom SharePoint site properties:** use the site metadata you already maintain.
2. **Microsoft Entra ID extension attributes:** group sites using the attributes already set in your directory.
3. **CSV site lists:** upload your own list of sites to create a custom group.

You don't have to rebuild your structure from scratch. Your catalog reflects how your organization is already set up, and it updates as your metadata changes.

_SharePoint admin configuring catalog groups with custom SharePoint site properties._

#### Governance Hub for Site Owners – Public Preview

Site owners have a critical role to play in ensuring accuracy of site information, including the site's necessity, its owners, members, permissions, and sharing settings. We’re introducing the **Governance Reviews Dashboard** , a centralized, actionable view where site owners can see **all pending site governance reviews** (inactivity, ownership, attestation, access reviews) across the sites they own.

The dashboard shows _required actions, due timelines, and site enforcement status_ and allows site owners to act directly from one place. Combined with **consolidated policy notifications** , it replaces multiple emails with a single, actionable governance surface.

Administrator performing a site governance review.

## Resilient AI: Business continuity even when agents go off script

Resiliency is all about business continuity so that in unexpected situations like ransomware incidents or agents gone rogue, which will happen, and accidentally deleting content you can recover quickly.

#### 1\. Agent rewind – Private Preview

Security 101 foundational primitive is – assume breach. In the same fashion in the AI agentic era, the first principle is – assume agents go rogue. But then, what will you do when an agent has gone rogue and deleted or made read-only massive number of resources in your Microsoft 365 tenancy? No worries, this is where Agent Rewind comes to action.

Today, we are thrilled to announce the Private Preview of Agent rewind, one of the existential resiliency capabilities that you need for this AI agentic era wherein you can rewind unintended actions. Simply pick a time stamp to which you want to “rewind” your Microsoft 365 resources, Agent Rewind will take care of brining that known good state. In fact, it can suggest to you a good time stamp too.

Connected with this preview, we are also launching in-line anomaly detection and prioritized recovery so that you can react to specific events like ransomware or mass deletions and recovery your most recently active content first to get back to business quickly.

Sign up here for the [preview here](https://aka.ms/AgentandContentGovernancePreviews) .

Rewinding Agentic actions.

#### 2\. Microsoft 365 Backup

In the AI era, the speed at which individuals get work done is greatly accelerated. So too is the speed at which bad actors can take advantage of weaknesses in cyber-attack scenarios, and the speed at which an inadvertent agentic action can take place. Given this, it's more important than ever to put proper resilience capabilities in place. Microsoft 365 Backup was built to do just that, in a uniquely secure, scalable, and performant manner.

For those not familiar, [Microsoft 365 Backup](https://aka.ms/m365backup) provides ultra-fast large scale and backup (near day-zero protection) and recovery capabilities. The solution is a critical component of any M365 customer’s cyber resiliency story. You can onboard the native M365 Backup application via the M365 admin center, or you can leverage a Microsoft 365 Backup Storage app built by the one of the recognized backup partner solutions.

Just be sure to ask for the version of the partner app built on M365 Backup Storage MBS to get the performance and security benefits of the platform. For example, [**Veeam Data Cloud Premium**](https://aka.ms/Microsoft365Backup/Veeam) and [**AvePoint Express Recovery for Microsoft 365**](https://aka.ms/Microsoft365Backup/AvePoint) . These vendors provide extended capabilities that deliver a fuller set of capabilities to you to ensure you never have to trade off speed for feature or service coverage. You can get everything you need and more with one of their better-together M365 Backup Storage hybrid solutions.

We heard from our customers and partners about the need to expand and extend native platform capabilities.

#### Teams Backup – Private Preview

Today, we’re expanding Microsoft 365 Backup with **Teams Channel Backup** in private preview, helping organizations protect the collaboration that keeps work moving. Administrators can protect channels and associated data within a Team, recover channels including their associated SharePoint content, and restore deleted or edited channel text messages within a 30-day recovery window.

New channels created in protected teams are automatically protected, reducing administrative effort and helping organizations recover from accidental deletion or unwanted changes with confidence. Note that hard deletion protection/recovery is not yet supported.

Interested in the preview, [sign up here](https://forms.cloud.microsoft/Pages/DesignPageV2.aspx?subpage=design&FormId=v4j5cvGGr0GRqy180BHbR_mCQfArPllNo4NRhexFZxRUMlZYVFJaR01aQlhMUVJXTExVMkxWV0RFSi4u) .

Back up Teams.

#### Entra Backup and Recovery Premium - Public preview

Business resilience starts with resilient identities. Today, we’re announcing the public preview of **Microsoft Entra Backup and Recovery Premium, integrated with Microsoft 365 Backup** . Daily snapshots provide a 30-day recovery window for users, groups, applications, and Conditional Access policies, and agent identities and agent blueprints, enhancing agentic resiliency.

Separately, hard deletion protection can now be enabled. Learn more about that [here](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/backup/configure-hard-deletion-protection) .

Back up and recover Entra assets.

#### 90-day to 10-year Backup Restore Point Retention Generally Available

Customers have varying recovery window needs. 90-day to 2 year protection and recovery windows is now generally available for OneDrive accounts, SharePoint sites, and Exchange Online mailboxes. Additionally, up to 10 year recovery window is now available for **SharePoint sites and OneDrive** **accounts** , helping organizations recover business-critical content long after a snapshot is created.

Administrators can configure each backup policy’s recovery window to **3 months, 6 months, or 1–10 years in one-year increments** . Longer recovery windows are opt-in, with recovery history building over time. Learn more about [configuring the backup recovery window](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/backup/backup-view-edit-policies) .

Configuring backup windows from 3 months to 10 years.

## Security & Compliance capabilities in SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams

#### 1\. App Intelligence for SharePoint and OneDrive – Generally Available Dec 2026

As AI-native apps multiply, admins need a clear answer to a simple question: which apps can reach our content, and should they? We have an answer for you.

Today, App Intelligence is generally available worldwide in the SharePoint admin center. It brings together application permissions and available activity data in one place, so admins can see which apps need attention, why they matter, and what to do next. Working with the SharePoint admin agent, admins can:

* **Review priority apps** that need immediate attention, based on permission scope, sensitive-site reach and observed activity.
* **Assess high privileged access** to focus on apps with broad or tenant-wide permissions, with a clear distinction between what an app is allowed to do and what it was actually observed doing.
* **Restrict access** when an app's risk warrants action, with guided steps to apply Restricted Access Control.
* **View the assessment report** and download the evidence needed for follow-up with security and compliance teams.

To get started, open App Intelligence in the SharePoint admin center and select Review priority apps in the Copilot pane. [Learn more Review application access with App Intelligence](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sharepoint/app-intelligence) .

App intelligence insights

#### 2\. SharePoint Content Events - Private Preview

Most security incidents are found too late, through a ticket or a report, after the damage has spread and is harder to contain. **SharePoint Content Events** changes that. It continuously monitors content activity across your tenant and alerts admins to unusual activity like mass deletions, mass downloads or oversharing. Admins can quickly tell a malicious attack from an honest mistake and act before it escalates.  
  
Today, we are excited to announce Content Events has entered Preview as part of SharePoint Advanced Management (SAM). Sign up for [Private Preview](https://aka.ms/AgentandContentGovernancePreviews) .

#### 3\. Microsoft Baseline Security Mode (BSM) 2026 – General Availability

Security is no longer a point-in-time deployment — it’s a continuous journey. At Ignite ’25, we [introduced Microsoft Baseline Security Mode 2025](https://aka.ms/MicrosoftBaselineSecurityMode) to help organizations move from one-time hardening to secure-by-default protections that keep pace as their environments change.

Today, we’re announcing the **General Availability of Microsoft Baseline Security Mode (BSM) 2026** , next major milestone in the BSM journey in helping organizations operationalize secure by default protections across their Microsoft environments. We are expanding with more Microsoft services configurations and adding application pillar. Check out [Microsoft baseline security mode blog](https://aka.ms/MicrosoftBaselinesecuritymode) .

#### 4\. Microsoft 365 Information Barriers (IB) enhancements

[Microsoft 365 Information Barriers (IB)](https://aka.ms/M365InfoBarriers) is a compliance control that prevents specific people or groups in an organization from communicating or collaborating with each other across Microsoft 365 services. It’s mainly used to avoid conflicts of interest and meet FINRA regulatory requirements.

We are happy to announce the following enhancements to Microsoft 365 Information barriers:

* **Teams Explicit Mode – Public Preview  
  ** We heard your feedback for enhancements in Teams IB. Today we are thrilled to announce public preview of Teams Explicit Mode support. With this control, admin can update an existing ‘Implicit’ mode Team to ‘Explicit’ mode. The access and sharing of the associated Team’s SharePoint site and Microsoft 365 group will honor the Explicit mode setting.
* **Agent Builder people picker experience honors Info Barriers – General availability**  
  We are thrilled to announce that agent builder people picker experience now honors information barriers (IB). With this control, users will only be able to share a declarative agent with other compatible users in the tenant.

[Learn about Information Barriers | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/information-barriers?view=o365-worldwide)

## Microsoft 365 Storage Management and Enterprise lifecycle

#### 1\. Microsoft 365 Archive

#### Automated file level archive in SharePoint – General Availability

You can now go to the SharePoint admin agent and ask it to:

_"Help create an inactive files archive policy by archiving all files that have not been accessed in 12 months."_

It is that simple to achieve archival of inactive content in SharePoint.

File level Archive gives you a way to detect and move inactive files without needing to archive the whole site, saving you 75% off list in storage costs. That content remains searchable by end users or admins, is easily reactivated in place by any user with file read permissions and continues to work seamlessly with Purview functionality. Best of all, you are only charged for usage if your total storage consumption is greater than your pre-allocated quota, and there are no reactivation fees (just like site archiving)!

Existing manual and API-based controls are still available, with controls spanning admin, site, file-level UI, and through Graph APIs or PowerShell.

Automated file level archive. Manage file level archive.

#### SAM (SharePoint Advanced Management) Inactive File Policy – Public Preview

To make the process of identifying and acting on inactive files, we are excited to announce inactive files policy - adding to our portfolio lifecycle products in SAM. Simply configure the inactivity period, file types, and scope of sites, and SAM lifecycle engine will take care of the rest.

Use the new [**_New-SPOFileArchivePolicy_**](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/microsoft.online.sharepoint.powershell/new-spofilearchivepolicy?view=sharepoint-ps) PowerShell cmdlet to create policies that automatically archive inactive SharePoint files, or ask the SharePoint admin agent to create the policies for you.

#### 2\. Microsoft 365 Storage Management Enhancements

#### SharePoint Admin Agent: Storage Skill – Generally Available

As referenced above, we heard your feedback to make storage management seamless, and this Ignite we are thrilled to share an agentic way to manage your storage growth. Announcing general availability of Storage Agentic Skill, part of the SharePoint Admin Agent. You can ask basic to advanced storage related questions to the agent, and it will do the hard work of analyzing all your sites in your tenant and provide answers and actionable insights.

#### Tenant-wide Version Trimming and What-if Analysis – Public Preview

The “what if analysis” capability gives you a way to test which versions the trimming feature will delete and what the impact of that action will be. You can then run the actual tenant-level trimming job to free up storage space. This is very similar to the existing site and doclib level trimming capabilities but expanded for a tenant-wide job. The tenant-wide version trimming and what-if analysis is available to all Copilot customers. The initial release will be via PowerShell only and will be followed up by SharePoint admin agent support. Learn more about [trimming versions at tenant level](https://learn.microsoft.com/sharepoint/trim-versions) .

#### SharePoint Extra Storage Pay-as-you-go Meter – General Availability in Jan. 2027

We’re also making it easier than ever to manage and pay for your active data.

**Microsoft 365 SharePoint Storage is in public preview and goes to general availability in Jan. 2027.** This pay-as-you-go meter allows you to grow your active storage usage with very little operational overhead. It works seamlessly with Microsoft 365 Archive so that you are charged the lowest possible blended rate only for storage that you're using on a daily basis (charged monthly). Archive usage is charged if total active + archive storage usage exceeds your pre-allocated quota. Now there's no need to prepay up to a year in advance for storage packs that you'll grow into later, no need to try to precisely manage that prepaid level through predictive efforts, and no risk of breaching storage payment compliance. Pricing for the pay-as-as-you-go meter matches the storage pack at $0.20/GB/month. Learn more about enabling [Microsoft 365 SharePoint Storage](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/commerce/add-storage-space?view=o365-worldwide) .

#### 3\. Microsoft 365 Enterprise Lifecycle Enhancements

#### Multi-Geo: Default geo move – Public Preview

[Microsoft 365 Multi Geo](https://aka.ms/M365MultiGeo) provides enterprise customers with the ability to expand their Microsoft 365 presence to multiple geographic regions within a single existing Microsoft 365 Tenant. A Multi-Geo tenant has a default geography, and one or more satellite geographies where their tenant data is stored.

As Microsoft opens new data centers in new countries, some customers wish to relocate their default geography to a new location. For example, a customer may choose to relocate their default geo from the Europe macro-region to the Germany local region, to ensure that data resides within Germany.

We are now enabling customers to change their primary geo for SharePoint and OneDrive from a broader region like Europe or Asia Pacific to a more specific local region like Germany or Korea, respectively. This capability is currently in public preview.

Nov 17, 2026

**In the AI era, governance isn't a barrier to innovation. It's what makes innovation possible at scale.**

Winning with Copilot and AI agents takes more than speed and scale. It requires **readiness to embrace AI and resilience to recover when things go wrong** . That's the power of AI-first governance: accelerating innovation, strengthening trust, and maximizing AI return on investment.

Today at Microsoft Ignite ’26, we're announcing exciting new content governance innovations to help organizations accelerate their [Frontier Transformation](https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2026/03/09/introducing-the-first-frontier-suite-built-on-intelligence-trust/) with AI Agents, Autopilots, Agent 365, and Work IQ.

## Governance innovations for resilient AI at scale

As you unveil AI Agents in your organization, either just getting started or deploying at scale, content governance becomes even more important to get right. **SharePoint is the #1 content citation source in Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI Agents** . Let us look into SharePoint content governance innovations across two main themes - readiness and resiliency, along with foundational security and enterprise lifecycle scenarios.

**Readiness for AI at scale** addresses oversharing, content lifecycle and sprawl, the risks boards now see as the biggest obstacles to AI transformation. New agentic skills power new security and storage management capabilities to address them.

**Resilient AI** is all about business continuity, especially in the era where agents are integral part of the workforce. Organizations must be prepared for unforeseen situations such as an agent going rogue and accidentally deleting content.

With this backdrop, let us dive into innovations across the following pillars:

Readiness for Copilot and AI Agents at Scale

SharePoint Admin Agent - Enhancements

Govern agents' traffic to M365 resources

Enhancements in SharePoint oversharing controls

Resilient AI: Business continuity even when agents go off script

Rewind when agents go off script

Microsoft 365 Backup: Teams support

Entra Backup

Security and Compliance capabilities in SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams

Microsoft 365 Storage Management and Enterprise Lifecycle

## Readiness for Copilot and AI Agents at Scale

Readiness is about ensuring your content is permissioned rightfully, organized in manageable clusters, has lifecycle guardrails, and in parallel knowing agent traffic across your Microsoft 365 estate _before_ AI Agents use it.

We are bringing many innovations to Copilot native governance capabilities powered by SAM (SharePoint Advanced Management) and to agent governance in the lens of Microsoft 365 resources. Let’s dive in.

#### 1\. SharePoint Admin Agent – Generally Available

At [Microsoft 365 Confernece’26](https://www.m365conf.com/) , we introduced the [SharePoint Admin Agent](https://aka.ms/M365-governance-agent) , Microsoft’s first-party AI assistant for managing your rapidly growing digital estate across Microsoft 365.

As the content backbone of Microsoft 365, SharePoint powers Teams, OneDrive, Loop, Copilot, and more. It sits at the center of content governance, spanning permissions, lifecycle, resilience, and relevance across users, apps, and now, AI agents.

The SharePoint Admin Agent brings these capabilities together in one simple conversational experience, with powerful skills across Permissions and Oversharing Management, Storage, Lifecycle, Multi-Geo, and Catalog. Today we are thrilled to announce many enhancements in the admin agent.

SharePoint Admin Agent skills

#### SharePoint Admin Agent’s Starter Prompts:

You can try various starter prompts categorized under various skills: Catalog, Permissions, Lifecycle, Storage, Organizational Settings and Multi-Geo.

#### Permissions and Oversharing Management skill – Generally Available

Admins can detect oversharing, see who has access to what and protect sensitive content, all in plain language. Ask _"Find overshared sites in my tenant"_ and the agent builds a prioritized list to review and act on, whether you have hundreds of sites or millions.

_SharePoint admin sees the permissions and oversharing skills of the SharePoint Management Agent in action._

#### Lifecycle skill – Generally Available

Ensuring content is current is critical to ensuring that Copilot serves the right content and with optimal utilization of storage. Helps admins stay in control of content from creation to end of life by identifying inactive, outdated, and ownerless sites and enabling actions like reviews and archival. For example, you could simply ask the agent: “ _List my inactive and ownerless sites_ ”.

_SharePoint admin sees the lifecycle skill of the SharePoint Management Agent in action._

#### Storage skill – Generally Available

Gives admins a clear view of tenant storage trends and active-versus-archive growth, helping them identify content sprawl, optimize capacity, and reduce unnecessary costs with confidence.

Here are some of the prompts that you can use in this v2 release, more enhancements are upcoming.

_"Compare active and archive SharePoint storage growth"_

_"Help me set up a file archive policy"_

_"How much version storage is used across the tenant?"_

_SharePoint admin sees the storage skill of the SharePoint Management Agent in action._

#### Multi-Geo skill – Generally Available

[Microsoft 365 Multi-Geo](https://aka.ms/M365MultiGeo) enables customers to comply with their organization's data residency requirements by ensuring that users' data is hosted within a specific geo where the user is located. The new **Multi-Geo skill in SharePoint Admin agent** assists the admin in moving the OneDrives to the user’s Preferred Data Location (PDL) along with following key capabilities:

* **Identify content to be moved**
* **Initiate moves:** Move OneDrive to users' Preferred Data Locations.
* **Monitor moves:** Track the status and progress of ongoing moves across OneDrive, SharePoint sites, and Microsoft 365 Groups.

The SharePoint admin sees the Multi-Geo skill in action.

#### Catalog skill – General Availability

The Catalog skill connects the SharePoint Admin Agent to Catalog Management, so the agent understands your tenant the way your business is organized. Using built-in categories like Department and Locale, along with any custom categories you've added, the agent can:

* **Show how content is organized in your tenant:** View site counts, site lists and groups of content in Catalog.
* **Organize content using the skill:** Leverage Catalog skill to create most relevant groups of SharePoint sites and OneDrive accounts with recommendations such as group sites in a certain department that are Highly Confidential.
* **Recommend next steps:** such as inactive content cleanup, archiving, version-history limits or a permissions review, scoped to the right group of sites instead of the whole tenant.

The SharePoint admin sees the catalog management skill in action.

#### Governance Hub for Admins – Generally Available Dec. 2026

As organizations accelerate their AI transformation, content governance can quickly become overwhelming. Admins don’t need more reports. They need to know what needs attention, what to do next, and have a simple way to act.

Today, we’re thrilled to introduce **Governance Hub** for Admins, **powered by the SharePoint Admin Agent** . It is readily available in Home tab of the SharePoint Admin Center and brings assessments, findings, recommendations, and actionable tasks together into a single experience - helping admins move from insight to action and govern content at scale

The SharePoint Admin Agent helps govern content from a single experience.

#### 2\. Agent governance in the lens of Microsoft 365 resources SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams

SharePoint and Teams administrators often ask – for my top secret and confidential resources, which agents are accessing them and who instantiated them, can I control at site or team level which agents are allowed? We have an answer for you.

Agent 365 offers a breadth view of all agents in your enterprise. To complement that breadth view, we are introducing depth view of agents in the lens of Microsoft 365 resources, specifically SharePoint sites, Teams, and OneDrive under the umbrella of Agent Lineage.

The new **Agent governance** node in the SharePoint admin center puts every agent governance action against Microsoft 365 resources in one place. Admins can go from insight to action without switching between reports and settings.

Govern how agents are interacting with content.

**Start with the Overview.** The Overview page gives you the big picture: how many agents are accessing your Microsoft 365 content, which agents and resources are most active, which content Microsoft 365 Copilot uses most, and how that access breaks down by sensitivity label and department. Suggested actions, such as restricted access control (RAC), restricted content discovery (RCD) and site access reviews, are one click away.

**Drill down with the Agent Access Heatmap.** It provides a panoramic view of your Microsoft 365 resources be it millions of SharePoint or OneDrive sites or Teams along with the agentic traffic.

#### Agent Access Heatmap for SharePoint and OneDrive – General Availability Dec’26

Agent Access Heatmap extends Microsoft Agent 365 capabilities with content context. The heatmap offers rich visual insights on agent access with additional dimensions like sensitivity, departments, and agent platforms – giving you visibility in a single view. Admins now have effective tools for observing and governing agent actions like pausing agentic access to a site or scoping more granular access. Find the busiest areas, then apply the appropriate content guardrails as needed.

#### Control whom an agentic user can collaborate with – Public Preview Dec. 2026

As agentic users proliferate in your organization, they can accumulate content permissions and further share it with other users in your organization while performing their work, like human users. To ensure agentic users securely collaborate with other users and in essence of work, you need a simple way to control which users the agentic users can collaborate with. We are thrilled to introduce a control that does just that.

When a new agent template is onboarded in Agent 365 portal, you can turn on the setting for “Restrict collaboration by agentic users” which will ensure agentic users associated with this agent template can only share sites and content with their manager.

Control with whom agentic users can collaborate.

While AI admins can set the collaboration boundary when onboarding an agent template in Agent 365,

SharePoint admins can now manage it, along with the rest of their agent content guardrails, from the new Settings page under Agent Governance in the SharePoint admin center. What you observe in the Agent Access Heatmap, you can now act on in **Settings** .

Agent governance settings.

#### Restricted access for apps and agents at site level – General Availability

Every Entra registered agent has a blueprint identity, much like third-party applications. The agent blueprints and applications with broad reaching permission across all sites or teams in your organization can increase the risk of data disclosure. We are thrilled to introduce restricted app access control - a [new setting](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sharepoint/restrict-application-agent-access#:~:text=Application%20Restrictions%20helps%20prevent%20oversharing%20to%20applications%20by,they%20hold%20Microsoft%20Entra%20consent%20and%20SharePoint%20permissions.) that empowers SharePoint Administrators to achieve fine-grained permissions by restricting which 3rd party applications or agent blueprints can access specific business critical sites or high-profile users' OneDrive data.

Simply run the cmdlet below using SharePoint Online Management PowerShell:

_Set-SPOSiteRestrictedAppAccessControlList –Identity <SiteURL> -ListType DenyList -AddRestrictedAppIds <ApporAgentBlueprintIDs>_

#### 3\. Enhancements in content oversharing controls from SharePoint Advanced Management (SAM)

#### Permissions and oversharing report for Autopilots & Groups - Generally Available

Site Permissions reports now extend to Microsoft 365 and Security Groups and Autopilots, enabling admins to instantly identify every site a user/group or autopilot can access and the scope of that access — closing a critical blind spot in oversharing governance. And clear remediation pathways are available through Restricted Access Control (RAC) and Restricted Content Discovery (RCD) policies.

[Learn more](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sharepoint/data-access-governance-reports) .

_SharePoint admin viewing permissions report for specific Autopilots users have instantiated_ _SharePoint admin viewing permissions report for specific large security groups._

#### Catalog management with custom SharePoint Properties – Generally Available

At Microsoft 365 Conference’26 we introduced [Catalog Management](https://aka.ms/CatalogManagement) V1. It brings order to sprawling SharePoint estates by grouping sites the way your business actually works: by department, region, project or function. The result is a central catalog of sites you can understand, govern and get ready for Copilot and agents.

Today, we're taking it further. You can now tailor Catalog Management to your tenant using information you already have. There are three new ways to customize your catalog:

1. **Custom SharePoint site properties:** use the site metadata you already maintain.
2. **Microsoft Entra ID extension attributes:** group sites using the attributes already set in your directory.
3. **CSV site lists:** upload your own list of sites to create a custom group.

You don't have to rebuild your structure from scratch. Your catalog reflects how your organization is already set up, and it updates as your metadata changes.

_SharePoint admin configuring catalog groups with custom SharePoint site properties._

#### Governance Hub for Site Owners – Public Preview

Site owners have a critical role to play in ensuring accuracy of site information, including the site's necessity, its owners, members, permissions, and sharing settings. We’re introducing the **Governance Reviews Dashboard** , a centralized, actionable view where site owners can see **all pending site governance reviews** (inactivity, ownership, attestation, access reviews) across the sites they own.

The dashboard shows _required actions, due timelines, and site enforcement status_ and allows site owners to act directly from one place. Combined with **consolidated policy notifications** , it replaces multiple emails with a single, actionable governance surface.

Administrator performing a site governance review.

## Resilient AI: Business continuity even when agents go off script

Resiliency is all about business continuity so that in unexpected situations like ransomware incidents or agents gone rogue, which will happen, and accidentally deleting content you can recover quickly.

#### 1\. Agent rewind – Private Preview

Security 101 foundational primitive is – assume breach. In the same fashion in the AI agentic era, the first principle is – assume agents go rogue. But then, what will you do when an agent has gone rogue and deleted or made read-only massive number of resources in your Microsoft 365 tenancy? No worries, this is where Agent Rewind comes to action.

Today, we are thrilled to announce the Private Preview of Agent rewind, one of the existential resiliency capabilities that you need for this AI agentic era wherein you can rewind unintended actions. Simply pick a time stamp to which you want to “rewind” your Microsoft 365 resources, Agent Rewind will take care of brining that known good state. In fact, it can suggest to you a good time stamp too.

Connected with this preview, we are also launching in-line anomaly detection and prioritized recovery so that you can react to specific events like ransomware or mass deletions and recovery your most recently active content first to get back to business quickly.

Sign up here for the [preview here](https://aka.ms/AgentandContentGovernancePreviews) .

Rewinding Agentic actions.

#### 2\. Microsoft 365 Backup

In the AI era, the speed at which individuals get work done is greatly accelerated. So too is the speed at which bad actors can take advantage of weaknesses in cyber-attack scenarios, and the speed at which an inadvertent agentic action can take place. Given this, it's more important than ever to put proper resilience capabilities in place. Microsoft 365 Backup was built to do just that, in a uniquely secure, scalable, and performant manner.

For those not familiar, [Microsoft 365 Backup](https://aka.ms/m365backup) provides ultra-fast large scale and backup (near day-zero protection) and recovery capabilities. The solution is a critical component of any M365 customer’s cyber resiliency story. You can onboard the native M365 Backup application via the M365 admin center, or you can leverage a Microsoft 365 Backup Storage app built by the one of the recognized backup partner solutions.

Just be sure to ask for the version of the partner app built on M365 Backup Storage MBS to get the performance and security benefits of the platform. For example, [**Veeam Data Cloud Premium**](https://aka.ms/Microsoft365Backup/Veeam) and [**AvePoint Express Recovery for Microsoft 365**](https://aka.ms/Microsoft365Backup/AvePoint) . These vendors provide extended capabilities that deliver a fuller set of capabilities to you to ensure you never have to trade off speed for feature or service coverage. You can get everything you need and more with one of their better-together M365 Backup Storage hybrid solutions.

We heard from our customers and partners about the need to expand and extend native platform capabilities.

#### Teams Backup – Private Preview

Today, we’re expanding Microsoft 365 Backup with **Teams Channel Backup** in private preview, helping organizations protect the collaboration that keeps work moving. Administrators can protect channels and associated data within a Team, recover channels including their associated SharePoint content, and restore deleted or edited channel text messages within a 30-day recovery window.

New channels created in protected teams are automatically protected, reducing administrative effort and helping organizations recover from accidental deletion or unwanted changes with confidence. Note that hard deletion protection/recovery is not yet supported.

Interested in the preview, [sign up here](https://forms.cloud.microsoft/Pages/DesignPageV2.aspx?subpage=design&FormId=v4j5cvGGr0GRqy180BHbR_mCQfArPllNo4NRhexFZxRUMlZYVFJaR01aQlhMUVJXTExVMkxWV0RFSi4u) .

Back up Teams.

#### Entra Backup and Recovery Premium - Public preview

Business resilience starts with resilient identities. Today, we’re announcing the public preview of **Microsoft Entra Backup and Recovery Premium, integrated with Microsoft 365 Backup** . Daily snapshots provide a 30-day recovery window for users, groups, applications, and Conditional Access policies, and agent identities and agent blueprints, enhancing agentic resiliency.

Separately, hard deletion protection can now be enabled. Learn more about that [here](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/backup/configure-hard-deletion-protection) .

Back up and recover Entra assets.

#### 90-day to 10-year Backup Restore Point Retention Generally Available

Customers have varying recovery window needs. 90-day to 2 year protection and recovery windows is now generally available for OneDrive accounts, SharePoint sites, and Exchange Online mailboxes. Additionally, up to 10 year recovery window is now available for **SharePoint sites and OneDrive** **accounts** , helping organizations recover business-critical content long after a snapshot is created.

Administrators can configure each backup policy’s recovery window to **3 months, 6 months, or 1–10 years in one-year increments** . Longer recovery windows are opt-in, with recovery history building over time. Learn more about [configuring the backup recovery window](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/backup/backup-view-edit-policies) .

Configuring backup windows from 3 months to 10 years.

## Security & Compliance capabilities in SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams

#### 1\. App Intelligence for SharePoint and OneDrive – Generally Available Dec 2026

As AI-native apps multiply, admins need a clear answer to a simple question: which apps can reach our content, and should they? We have an answer for you.

Today, App Intelligence is generally available worldwide in the SharePoint admin center. It brings together application permissions and available activity data in one place, so admins can see which apps need attention, why they matter, and what to do next. Working with the SharePoint admin agent, admins can:

* **Review priority apps** that need immediate attention, based on permission scope, sensitive-site reach and observed activity.
* **Assess high privileged access** to focus on apps with broad or tenant-wide permissions, with a clear distinction between what an app is allowed to do and what it was actually observed doing.
* **Restrict access** when an app's risk warrants action, with guided steps to apply Restricted Access Control.
* **View the assessment report** and download the evidence needed for follow-up with security and compliance teams.

To get started, open App Intelligence in the SharePoint admin center and select Review priority apps in the Copilot pane. [Learn more Review application access with App Intelligence](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sharepoint/app-intelligence) .

App intelligence insights

#### 2\. SharePoint Content Events - Private Preview

Most security incidents are found too late, through a ticket or a report, after the damage has spread and is harder to contain. **SharePoint Content Events** changes that. It continuously monitors content activity across your tenant and alerts admins to unusual activity like mass deletions, mass downloads or oversharing. Admins can quickly tell a malicious attack from an honest mistake and act before it escalates.  
  
Today, we are excited to announce Content Events has entered Preview as part of SharePoint Advanced Management (SAM). Sign up for [Private Preview](https://aka.ms/AgentandContentGovernancePreviews) .

#### 3\. Microsoft Baseline Security Mode (BSM) 2026 – General Availability

Security is no longer a point-in-time deployment — it’s a continuous journey. At Ignite ’25, we [introduced Microsoft Baseline Security Mode 2025](https://aka.ms/MicrosoftBaselineSecurityMode) to help organizations move from one-time hardening to secure-by-default protections that keep pace as their environments change.

Today, we’re announcing the **General Availability of Microsoft Baseline Security Mode (BSM) 2026** , next major milestone in the BSM journey in helping organizations operationalize secure by default protections across their Microsoft environments. We are expanding with more Microsoft services configurations and adding application pillar. Check out [Microsoft baseline security mode blog](https://aka.ms/MicrosoftBaselinesecuritymode) .

#### 4\. Microsoft 365 Information Barriers (IB) enhancements

[Microsoft 365 Information Barriers (IB)](https://aka.ms/M365InfoBarriers) is a compliance control that prevents specific people or groups in an organization from communicating or collaborating with each other across Microsoft 365 services. It’s mainly used to avoid conflicts of interest and meet FINRA regulatory requirements.

We are happy to announce the following enhancements to Microsoft 365 Information barriers:

* **Teams Explicit Mode – Public Preview  
  ** We heard your feedback for enhancements in Teams IB. Today we are thrilled to announce public preview of Teams Explicit Mode support. With this control, admin can update an existing ‘Implicit’ mode Team to ‘Explicit’ mode. The access and sharing of the associated Team’s SharePoint site and Microsoft 365 group will honor the Explicit mode setting.
* **Agent Builder people picker experience honors Info Barriers – General availability**  
  We are thrilled to announce that agent builder people picker experience now honors information barriers (IB). With this control, users will only be able to share a declarative agent with other compatible users in the tenant.

[Learn about Information Barriers | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/information-barriers?view=o365-worldwide)

## Microsoft 365 Storage Management and Enterprise lifecycle

#### 1\. Microsoft 365 Archive

#### Automated file level archive in SharePoint – General Availability

You can now go to the SharePoint admin agent and ask it to:

_"Help create an inactive files archive policy by archiving all files that have not been accessed in 12 months."_

It is that simple to achieve archival of inactive content in SharePoint.

File level Archive gives you a way to detect and move inactive files without needing to archive the whole site, saving you 75% off list in storage costs. That content remains searchable by end users or admins, is easily reactivated in place by any user with file read permissions and continues to work seamlessly with Purview functionality. Best of all, you are only charged for usage if your total storage consumption is greater than your pre-allocated quota, and there are no reactivation fees (just like site archiving)!

Existing manual and API-based controls are still available, with controls spanning admin, site, file-level UI, and through Graph APIs or PowerShell.

Automated file level archive. Manage file level archive.

#### SAM (SharePoint Advanced Management) Inactive File Policy – Public Preview

To make the process of identifying and acting on inactive files, we are excited to announce inactive files policy - adding to our portfolio lifecycle products in SAM. Simply configure the inactivity period, file types, and scope of sites, and SAM lifecycle engine will take care of the rest.

Use the new [**_New-SPOFileArchivePolicy_**](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/microsoft.online.sharepoint.powershell/new-spofilearchivepolicy?view=sharepoint-ps) PowerShell cmdlet to create policies that automatically archive inactive SharePoint files, or ask the SharePoint admin agent to create the policies for you.

#### 2\. Microsoft 365 Storage Management Enhancements

#### SharePoint Admin Agent: Storage Skill – Generally Available

As referenced above, we heard your feedback to make storage management seamless, and this Ignite we are thrilled to share an agentic way to manage your storage growth. Announcing general availability of Storage Agentic Skill, part of the SharePoint Admin Agent. You can ask basic to advanced storage related questions to the agent, and it will do the hard work of analyzing all your sites in your tenant and provide answers and actionable insights.

#### Tenant-wide Version Trimming and What-if Analysis – Public Preview

The “what if analysis” capability gives you a way to test which versions the trimming feature will delete and what the impact of that action will be. You can then run the actual tenant-level trimming job to free up storage space. This is very similar to the existing site and doclib level trimming capabilities but expanded for a tenant-wide job. The tenant-wide version trimming and what-if analysis is available to all Copilot customers. The initial release will be via PowerShell only and will be followed up by SharePoint admin agent support. Learn more about [trimming versions at tenant level](https://learn.microsoft.com/sharepoint/trim-versions) .

#### SharePoint Extra Storage Pay-as-you-go Meter – General Availability in Jan. 2027

We’re also making it easier than ever to manage and pay for your active data.

**Microsoft 365 SharePoint Storage is in public preview and goes to general availability in Jan. 2027.** This pay-as-you-go meter allows you to grow your active storage usage with very little operational overhead. It works seamlessly with Microsoft 365 Archive so that you are charged the lowest possible blended rate only for storage that you're using on a daily basis (charged monthly). Archive usage is charged if total active + archive storage usage exceeds your pre-allocated quota. Now there's no need to prepay up to a year in advance for storage packs that you'll grow into later, no need to try to precisely manage that prepaid level through predictive efforts, and no risk of breaching storage payment compliance. Pricing for the pay-as-as-you-go meter matches the storage pack at $0.20/GB/month. Learn more about enabling [Microsoft 365 SharePoint Storage](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/commerce/add-storage-space?view=o365-worldwide) .

#### 3\. Microsoft 365 Enterprise Lifecycle Enhancements

#### Multi-Geo: Default geo move – Public Preview

[Microsoft 365 Multi Geo](https://aka.ms/M365MultiGeo) provides enterprise customers with the ability to expand their Microsoft 365 presence to multiple geographic regions within a single existing Microsoft 365 Tenant. A Multi-Geo tenant has a default geography, and one or more satellite geographies where their tenant data is stored.

As Microsoft opens new data centers in new countries, some customers wish to relocate their default geography to a new location. For example, a customer may choose to relocate their default geo from the Europe macro-region to the Germany local region, to ensure that data resides within Germany.

We are now enabling customers to change their primary geo for SharePoint and OneDrive from a broader region like Europe or Asia Pacific to a more specific local region like Germany or Korea, respectively. This capability is currently in public preview.

For all the private previews mentioned in this blog, you can sign up [Private Preview](https://aka.ms/AgentandContentGovernancePreviews) .

In addition, natural and expressive voices are required for voiceover, e-learning and read-aloud content, and other apps need voices that sound clear and engaging. At Ignite 2026, we are delivering two updates: a better and broader set of Neural HD standard voices, and the new VASA-2 photo avatar.

* **New update for Neural HD standard voices:** Besides the Neural HD v3 voices enhancement covered in voice agent scenario, we also extend our Neural HD standard voice offering with the **Partner Voices (Public Preview)** , which brings HD voices built by partners such as DataoceanAI and Telus into Microsoft Foundry. Partner voices give customers more choices to find the right one for both their voice agents and content creation scenarios.

VASA-2 photo avatar is specially designed to enrich the voice agent experience to be more engaged and personal. In Ignite 2026, we bring VASA-2 turns a single photo into a lifelike, upper-body talking avatar, an important upgrade from the talking head of VASA-1. It also moves more naturally and gives you more control over facial expressions to fit your scenario. [Learn more.](https://youtu.be/LPX2UH0TnlM?list=PLLV-DvlBi2ME)

##### **Speech translation** : talk across languages in your own voice

Language should not stand between people. Live Interpreter API , our real-time speech-to-speech translation service, now runs on a new LLM-based model that translates speech while people are still talking.

* **Breakthrough translation quality** **:** 30% fewer translation errors than the previous production model.

* **Fast response:** Translates end to end in under 3 seconds, on par with professional human interpreters.

* **Your voice in every language:** With Personal Voice, Live Interpreter API keeps the speaker's voice, style and tone in each language, so conversations feel natural and personal. [Learn more](https://aka.ms/live-interpreter)

Customers are already using Live Interpreter for contact center agent assist, on phones and smart devices such as earbuds and AI glasses, and in international meetings.

#### G et started today

**Build voice agents:** Getting started only takes a few steps:

1. Open the [Microsoft Foundry portal](https://aka.ms/voice-agent) go to **Build** , **Agents** and **New agent** , select “ **Voice** ”.
2. Choose a voice-optimized model and configure your agent's instructions.
3. Connect knowledge sources and tools as needed for your scenario.
4. Test conversations directly in the built-in voice playground.
5. Deploy to your desired channels and monitor performance using built-in observability and evaluation capabilities.

**Explore Speech in Microsoft Foundry.** Use the Speech playgrounds in [Microsoft Foundry Portal](https://learn.microsoft.com/) to try Speech transcription, voices, avatars and Speech translation. When you’re ready to integrate speech into an application, start with the [Speech SDK](https://aka.ms/speechsdk) and [Speech in Microsoft Foundry documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/) .
